audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart said 'Skill' for six of seven rows while the content layer and the packet chart both say Brand/Brand/Skill/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie. Two different answers rendered to the same reader.
audit.why: Brand's Sear reaches 1050 vs Annie's 625 Q, so levels 1-2 are his; from 4 onward Annie's stocked Pyromania makes point-and-click stun beat a conditional one.
audit.corrected: Full phases[].side realigned to the content/packet chart, with ratings and whys following.

audit.why: Level 6 (Flash-Tibbers), first burst item, and Rabadon's are the real Annie spikes; Brand's are Pillar rank-ups and Liandry-class burn.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] reworded to name Pyroclasm (100/90/80s) instead of calling Brand's ultimate 'Pillar'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was gestured at but never nailed: Sear only stuns a target already carrying Blaze, so the ability to dodge is Pillar of Flame / Conflagration, not the Q itself.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.' Blaze is applied by any Brand spell, so staying clean of W (8s at rank 5) and E (9s at rank 5) makes his Q a nuke he cannot follow up on.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[1].d now key Molten Shield (10s) and positioning to Pillar of Flame's landing delay rather than to the Q line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's derived flags put 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' on Pillar of Flame.
audit.why: Riot's own description for Pillar of Flame describes a delayed area of magic damage with no terrain creation. Per instructions, the description wins over a misfiring derived flag.
audit.corrected: No page text asserts Pillar terrain; flag recorded as a parse error only.

edits.before: Q last-hits refund mana on kill — farm with it for free and let the stun counter tick where he can see it.
edits.after: Sear outranges you 1050 to 625 — take free Q last-hits for the mana refund and let the stun counter tick untouched.

edits.before: W joins the stack engine: the cone clears and counts. A stocked stun at level 2 already makes him flinch.
edits.after: W joins the stack engine, but Pillar of Flame every 8s zones the wave — stack from range, don't step into the circle.

edits.before: Hold the four-stack glow and watch him orbit at max range — a stocked Annie controls the lane by standing there.
edits.after: Hold the four-stack glow: a point-and-click stun beats a Sear that only stuns once his W or E has lit you up.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Brand wins by lighting you with Pillar of Flame so Sear turns into a stun, then chaining Conflagration.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Molten Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): Q stuns only if Blaze is already on you, so the dodges that matter are Pillar of Flame (8s) and Conflagration (9s) — clean of burn, his Q is a nuke, not a lockdown. - Molten Shield is 10s; hold it for his opener. - Tibbers goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry the one button — Flash-Tibbers onto Brand mid-Pyroclasm ends the bounce and the fight; engineer that radius.

edits.before: If Brand opens the score, reset expectations and respect Sear (Stun) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Brand opens the score, never walk up ablaze — Sear needs Blaze on you before it stuns. Farm with Q refunds under tower, buy Null-Magic Mantle early, and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.

edits.before: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, zone Brand off CS by existing, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.
edits.after: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, deny CS inside his 1050 Sear range, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.

edits.before: At four stacks: walk forward, Q-stun, W, auto, walk away re-stacking off the wave — a guaranteed chunk he answered with nothing.
edits.after: Molten Shield's 10s cooldown covers Pillar of Flame's landing delay — pop it as the circle appears and his first Blaze stack never sticks.

edits.before: Brand whiffs Sear (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Sear is down 6s after a whiff — step up and trade inside it.

edits.before: That is Brand’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Three stacks is no stun — his Q-W-E chain out-damages yours.

edits.before: Both ults are wave-clear/burst tools, but Pyromania stun plus Tibbers lets you force a real all-in while Brand's Pillar is mostly a poke reset.
edits.after: Tibbers plus a stocked Pyromania forces a real all-in; Pyroclasm on a 100s cooldown bounces for damage but never stops your commit.

notes: Level chart was split between layers (full said Skill on 6 of 7 rows; content and packet agreed on Brand/Brand/Skill/Annie/Annie/Annie/Annie) — proposed as one atomic group on the full side only, since content already matched the packet. Derived-flag error: brief marks Brand W 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes'; Riot's description has no terrain component — treated as tooltip-parse misfire and not written to the page. Left templated but ungroundable without invention: breakdown.wave, breakdown.mid, breakdown.late, tradeGood/tradeBad (they are Annie-generic but factually correct).
